title: V2 Poseidon2b nonlinear-subspace reproduction
description: Reproduce the matrix rank, trail lengths and exact Macaulay projections from the Poseidon2b implementation shipped in v2.0.3. This is a component audit, not an end-to-end security bound.
acceptance: The trusted verifier archives the pinned production commit, builds the integrated calculator with locked release dependencies and compares its authenticated inputs and exact output with every frozen contract field. Contributor code is never executed.
